final: WITH sex_stats AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) as exam_count FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), totals AS (SELECT SUM(exam_count) as total_count, AVG(exam_count) as avg_per_sex FROM sex_stats), above_avg AS (SELECT ss.SEX, ss.exam_count, CAST(ss.exam_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as share, ss.exam_count - t.avg_per_sex as excess FROM sex_stats ss CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE ss.exam_count > t.avg_per_sex) SELECT SUM(exam_count) as total_count_above_avg, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
